messages:
matt: Heads-up — noticed a failing integration test in staging after the py/ts SDK publish this morning. auth header mutated for token refresh flow. Quiet window, but putting this thread here to coordinate a minimal roll/patch.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary -> py-ts-sdk@2026.3.1-canary at 2539990010 :rocket:

arleen: @matt can you paste the failing stacktrace? want to know if this needs a hotpatch or a revert. :eyes:

matt: short trace: `AuthClient._refresh()` returns header with duplicate "authorization" keys causing downstream header merge to pick wrong one. small repro in unit tests. failing in 2/3 of canary nodes.

luis: Repro is great, thx. quick check: did we ship the new header-normalization helper from the http layer? I think the TS patch wasn't bundled into the wheel due to setup.cfg include mismatch.

jenna: If packaging caused omission we should pivot to pinning older dist-tags and stop the rest of the rollout. Propose: pause any further canary -> stable promotion, create rollback tag for py & ts, then republish fixed artifacts.

devex-oncall: Agree with pause. Criteria for rollback: (1) failing e2e in staging >1m, (2) request error rate >0.5% in canary. We hit (1) now, so proceed to stop promote.

matt: OK can someone run the pin commands? I'll prepare the patch and changelog entry.

luis: Running npm/pip commands now:
```bash
# npm: pin canary back to previous dist-tag
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@2026.3.0 stable
# pip: yank the broken wheel and re-upload fixed one after CI
twine upload dist/redwood_sdk-2026.3.1-py3-none-any.whl
```
I'll wait to yank until jenna confirms rollback plan.

jenna: Do not yank yet — we should add a deprecation note for the sync client behavior in the changelog if we change header merging semantics. For now: create a release note that marks 2026.3.1 canary as blocked and attach the repro. I created an issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SDK-6723

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by @jenna at 2539990028. Canary traffic stable but no stable tag update.

sre-bot: Alert: staging e2e failures increased at 2539990036, creating incident stub: INC-2026-042. Logging traces to /incidents/INC-2026-042.

arleen: Quick decision: rollback vs patch? Patch is fine if we can release within the quiet window and republish within 30m. If publish takes >30m we'll revert to 2026.3.0 across channels. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt: I can ship a patch that re-adds header normalization and update tests within 20m, but needs CI wheels to finish. If CI looks green by +25m, we republish fixed artifacts and then promote. If not, rollback to 2026.3.0 stable.

jenna: Approved plan. luis, once matt's PR is up and CI passes, coordinate with devex-oncall to republish and I'll run the dist-tag flip. If CI fails, luis please pin back and I'll announce rollback and update release-notes.

luis: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4132 — includes tests. Triggering CI.

deploy-bot: Canary build logs available: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/9999 (2539990038)

matt: CI green on unit + staging smoke at 2539990042. Ready to republish when luis pushes artifacts.

luis: Republished fixed artifacts and bumped canary tag. Running dist-tag flip now.

deploy-bot: Dist-tag updated: @redwood/sdk-js@2026.3.1 -> stable (2539990045) :shipit: (deferred until jenna gives final ack)

jenna: Final ack withheld — double-checking release notes and deprecation blurb. I'll post the announcement in #announcements once I confirm wording. For tracking: created a follow-up PR to add explicit compatibility test for header merges.

matt: Thanks all. Postmortem / short blameless note incoming in #postmortems after we close INC-2026-042.

arleen: Adding a checklist for future: 1) release manifest includes compiled http helper 2) sanity smoke run before dist-tag flip 3) automated header-merge e2e test 4) run canary for 15m before stable. We'll add to release playbook.

jenna: Recording stakeholder notify: growth + partner teams. I'll draft the rollback/release note with clear guidance for customers pinned to 2026.3.0. :white_check_mark:
